The hedge fund held 283,026 shares of the water supply company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.68 million, up from 233,026 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hartwell J M Limited Partnership who had been investing in Pure Cycle Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $231.70 million market cap company. Pure Cycle Corporation (NASDAQ:PCYO) has risen 21.29% since June 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 8.72% the S&P500.
